correctness.rationale: Reconstructed majority-component property for 2k+1 independent arclength samples: for each arm i, median radius exceeds t iff its outer subarm contains at least k+1 samples. The disjoint binomial-majority events yield sum_i B_k((a_i-t)_+/L). For two arms q>=r with q+r<=1, q(1-q)-r(1-r)=(q-r)(1-q-r)>=0 gives monotone B derivatives for every inequality-increasing transfer; third strictly positive arm gives strictness at t=0. At each length s, the (k+1)st derivative jump is c_k n_s/L^(k+1) with same sign. Weighted jump sum c_k/L^k recovers scale/multiplicities. Independent exact rational four-arm k=2 probe checked stochastic transfer and repeated-length inversion; examined actual verify.py. Scope m>=3, k>=1, exact law, no noisy tomography.
